**Summary of the Key Financial and Legal Terms of this Agreement**

This agreement outlines the terms of a loan between Yaswanth Kumar Reddy (the Borrower) and BANK (the Lender). The key financial and legal terms are as follows:

**Loan Details**

The Borrower is borrowing $10,000 from the Lender at an annual interest rate of 8%, compounded annually. The loan can be repaid in one of three ways: weekly payments (amount not specified), monthly payments of $313.36 starting on November 8, 2025, and ending on October 8, 2028, or a lump sum payment (amount not specified).

**Payment and Late Fee**

If any payment is 10 days late, the Lender shall charge a late fee of $25. Payments are applied first to any accrued interest and secondly to the principal balance.

**Security**

The loan is either secured or unsecured, depending on the option chosen. If secured, the Lender has the right to declare the loan and security immediately due and payable in the event of default.

**Prepayment and Remedies**

The Borrower has the right to pay back the loan in full or make additional payments at any time without penalty. The Lender has the right to declare the loan and security immediately due and payable in the event of default.

**Events of Acceleration and Subordination**

The occurrence of certain events, such as the Borrower's failure to pay any part of the principal or interest, shall constitute an "Event of Acceleration" by the Lender. The Borrower's obligations under this Agreement are subordinated to all indebtedness of the Borrower or any unrelated third-party lender.

**Governing Law and Additional Terms**

This Agreement shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws in the State of Massachusetts. The Borrower and Lender agree to be bound by the terms and conditions of this Agreement, including any additional terms and conditions that may be added in the future.
